title: My custom combat is coming along! How does it look so far? (Mix of D&D, Souls and Fear & Hunger)

posts.author: musty
posts.body:
Hey guys, i've decided to start my first videogame project in RPG Maker MV by recreating an old ruleset i've designed for a D&D One-Shot in the Dark Souls universe
(which never ended up happening :c)
I never really known about this engine until i've played Fear And Hunger 1 last year which i absolutely loved and i'm taking a lot of inspiration from.
I've changed up a bit my original ruleset to make it possible on this engine because i have no idea how to do some of the stuff, i even made some posts about asking if it's possible to make some of the systems, but for now, i think i've reached my skill ceiling lmao.
I've still gotta work on balancing the enemies and add more skills and consumables for further strategical options
but i'm really proud of what came out with it so far.
The combat focuses on Stamina management for both player AND enemies.
I loved the limb system in Funger so i've decided to implement it here aswell, all limbs share the same amount of stamina, some of them are vital and there are many other parameters i can control.
And everything is processed through the D&D dice and statistics system.
I'd love to hear what you guys think about it so far
AI was only used as a coding assistant for JavaScript plugins
